NoteHow to read this




South-facing is the share of the parcel whose slope faces between SE and SW.
Winter noon sun is the direct sunlight at solar noon on the winter solstice, relative to flat ground. Above 1 means the slope tilts towards the winter sun; 0 means the slope puts the parcel in its own shade.
Zoning and constraints show the dominant class of each planning layer on the parcel and the share of the parcel it covers. Codes are translated from Italian; see each house page for the full layer descriptions.

title: Option 1 — Barge
text:
Summary
The house point (44.716063, 7.278993) is in Barge and falls on cadastral sheet 86, parcel 226, a 3,047 m² parcel (cadastral record: 2,904 m²). The ground lies between 836 and 863 m above sea level (mean 852 m). The mean slope is 16.9° (30%, steep), and the parcel faces E on average. 0% of its area faces SE–SW. No cadastral building lies on the parcel.

Coordinates: 44.716063, 7.278993 (Google Maps)
Cadastre portal: Barge
Parcels within 100 m: 24

title: Option 1 — Barge
text:
Planning and constraints

Zoning (land-use designations) (AreNor): AAM - agricultural area, mountain (likely ‘aree agricole montane’) (100%)
Land-use zones of the town plan (PRG) (‘aree normative’). The zone code determines what may be built.
Geological hazard classes (PAI 2008) (PAI2008): PAI class III undifferentiated (area 1) - high hazard; new building generally not allowed (100%)
Town-plan map of geomorphological hazard and building suitability (PAI adaptation, 2008), following Piedmont Circ. 7/LAP: class I no constraints, class II moderate hazard (building allowed with technical measures), class III high hazard (new building generally not allowed).
Mountain zone (zona montana): present (100%)
Part of the comune classified as mountain territory.
Hydrogeological restriction (Vincolo Idrogeologico): Hydrogeological restriction (100%)
Area under ‘vincolo idrogeologico’ (R.D. 3267/1923, L.R. 45/1989): earthworks, tree felling and land-use changes need an authorisation.







Warning



These layers come from the comune’s public GIS viewer and are for orientation only. Check the current town plan (PRG) and the certificato di destinazione urbanistica with the comune before relying on them.

title: Option 2 — Bagnolo Piemonte
text:
Planning and constraints

Zoning (land-use designations) (Destinazioni urbanistiche): E - agricultural zone (100%)
Land-use zones of the town plan (PRG). The zone code determines what may be built.
Hydrogeological restriction (Vincolo idrogeologico): does not apply to this parcel
Area under ‘vincolo idrogeologico’ (R.D. 3267/1923, L.R. 45/1989): earthworks, tree felling and land-use changes need an authorisation.
Forests and woodland (statutory landscape protection) (Lettera g) i territori coperti da foreste e boschi): does not apply to this parcel
Art. 142(1)(g) D.Lgs. 42/2004: land covered by forest is a protected landscape asset. Works need a landscape authorisation.
Landscape areas (PPR) (Ambiti di paesaggio): Plain landscape area (Ambito Piana) (100%)
Landscape area (‘ambito’) of the Piedmont Regional Landscape Plan.
Landscape units (PPR) (Unità di paesaggio): Rural (55%)
Landscape unit of the Piedmont Regional Landscape Plan, with its character type.
Forest cover (PPR) (CoperturaBoscata): does not apply to this parcel
Forest cover mapped by the Regional Landscape Plan (Table P4).
Settlement morphology (PPR) (Morfologie insediative): m.i. 10 - rural areas of plain or hill (PPR settlement class 10) (100%)
Settlement pattern class of the Regional Landscape Plan (Table P4, art. 34-40 NdA); each class has its own building rules.







Warning



These layers come from the comune’s public GIS viewer and are for orientation only. Check the current town plan (PRG) and the certificato di destinazione urbanistica with the comune before relying on them.
